g.title: flow
g.text: Recall — PROPOSED (design-for-scaling): bounded parallelism · ML-concurrent / Python-serial-by-default · CE passes SEPARATE-concurrent (not merged) · async side-effects · Ettin-target

NOT BUILT — build gated on post-Ettin measurement. `--cpus 2` = accessibility FLOOR, not ceiling: parallel STRUCTURE + BOUNDED thread budget (≈ncpu split across tasks) → 2 cores ~sequential (no thrash), more cores fan out. All time_ms PENDING MEASUREMENT.

g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: DESIGN LEGEND — read first (PROPOSED, not built)

g.title: cluster_core
g.text: Core process — thin shim only (forward in / return out)

g.title: cluster_backend
g.text: Backend — ENTIRE pipeline relocated here (#85): SurrealDB + rerank + embed, bounded-parallel gather

g.title: lg_rule
g.text: parallel STRUCTURE + total threads ≈ ncpu, split across concurrent tasks
2 cores → ~1 thread/task → ~sequential (graceful, NO thrash) · more cores → fan out, speed up

g.title: lg_gil
g.text: parallel-safe (native, GIL-release): embed · KNN · CE passes → parallelize freely, degrade gracefully to serial
serial-by-default (GIL-bound): convex fusion · PPR · spreading BFS compute → parallelize ONLY if MEASURED (multiprocessing = floor-case LOSS on 2 cores)
mixed: spreading = per-depth DB IO overlaps, BFS compute does not

g.title: lg_ce
g.text: merging saves ≈0 compute (pairs sum) + adds quality risk
concurrent CE needs REPLICATED model instances or a batching inference server — not just threads
Ettin-32M/68M target (Train 2) → ~2-6× cheaper/pass · keep-warm kills ~7 s cold-load · warm CE ≈3.9 s/pass (micro-bench, not 11.3 s cold)

g.title: n6
g.text: per-depth DB IO overlaps · BFS compute serial · MIXED (gather long-pole)
